newsitem.title: USA: Giant Cement gets $30 mln credit facility.
newsitem.headline: Giant Cement gets $30 mln credit facility.

text.p: Giant Cement Holding Inc said Thursday it entered into an agreement with SouthTrust Bank of Alabama NA for a $30 million revolving credit facility.
The facility is for a term of three years and provides an additional $2 million for letters of credit.

"The terms of the facility are favorable to those of the company's existing credit facilities, which will result in cost savings as well as provide the company with greater flexibility," Giant Cement Chief Financial Officer Terry Kinder said in a statement.
The company said it plans to use the credit facility to refinance the majority of its existing long-term debt as well as for working capital.
